statements.statement: The patient presents with exertional dyspnea and palpitations
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
A 48-hour Holter monitoring study (CPT 93226) is ordered
The study is ordered to evaluate for paroxysmal arrhythmias that may be contributing to these symptoms
The study is ordered to assess the hemodynamic impact of the valvular regurgitation
